in_marathi.name: Siddhesh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Achievement of Goals
in_marathi.long_meaning: Siddhesh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Siddhi’ which means ‘achievement’ or ‘success’, Siddhesh is a name that embodies the spirit of accomplishment and victory. It is believed to bring good fortune and success in all endeavors. In Hindu mythology, Siddhesh is the name of a celestial being who is the embodiment of divine power and fulfillment.
